title: John Franklin-Myers: Best part of joining Titans is having people you've bled with in the past

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Franklin-Myers: Best part of joining Titans is having people you've bled with in the past
sources.description: Defensive lineman John Franklin-Myers will be with a new team in 2026, but his transition to the Titans will be a smoother one thanks to some familiar faces in the building.
